The '''Republic Customs Office''' was the organizations charged with preventing illegal trade of [[Spice/Legends|spices]] and other illicit goods within the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]].

==Role==
The Republic Customs Office was responsible for regulating the flow of goods within the Republic and preventing the trade of illicit materials<ref name="Beryl" /> such as [[Spice/Legends|spice]].<ref name="Best" /> As part of their job regulating the economy, Customs personnel could impound [[Starship/Legends|starships]] if they considered the vessel or its crew to be suspect.<ref name="Beryl" />

==History==
Founded sometime before the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the office had [[Agent/Legends|agents]] stationed on [[Planet/Legends|planets]] across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. Agent [[Soganti]] was assigned to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="Time">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> and he attempted to investigate the activities of the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Beryl Thorne]] but failed to find enough evidence on her.<ref name="The Vault">{{TORcite|type=class|Smuggler|The Vault|Taris}}</ref>

In [[3642 BBY]],<ref name="Time" /> when the combat medic [[Archiban Frodrick Kimble|Archiban Kimble]] was being blackmailed by criminals on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] into delivering a shipment of spice in exchange for the life of his ex-fiancé [[Prudy]], he contacted Republic Customs. Customs sent Kimble, better known as Doc, undercover on their behalf so that they could arrest the criminals, but the plan went sour and Customs was forced to send in hostage negotiators to ensure Prudy and Doc's safety.<ref name="Best" />

==Behind the scenes==
Republic Customs first appeared in the [[2011]] [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', in the Smuggler and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] class storylines. Agent Soganti appears twice in the Smuggler class storyline on Taris,<ref name="Beryl" /> where he is pursuing Beryl Thorne,<ref name="The Vault" /> and Customs is also mentioned in the conversation "The Best Intentions" with the Knight class's companion Doc. The situation with Republic Customs in that conversation replaced a previous version of the mission where the player would accompany Doc to Alderaan and confront the criminal [[Cazzush]], but that iteration was cut before the game's release.<ref name="Best" />
